fact: ARTAC, chaired by the director general of ARPCE Congo, signed a memorandum with Smart Africa on 27 October 2022 in Kigali; Congo's regulator has been an ARTAC member since 2004.
title: A Kigali, l'ARTAC et l'Alliance Smart Africa unissent leurs forces pour relever les défis des télécoms en Afrique centrale
